description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractMetaDataParser' for parsing and managing metadata related to modules in the SuiteCRM project. It includes properties and methods for handling field definitions, view definitions, language, history, and layout panels, as well as static utility functions for working with field properties.

classes.name: AbstractMetaDataParser
classes.description: An abstract class providing a foundation for parsing module metadata such as field definitions and layout panels, supporting operations like retrieving layout, language, history, and filtering fields.

methods.name: getLayoutAsArray
methods.description: Returns the layout panels of the module as an array.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the language associated with the metadata implementation.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves the history object associated with the metadata implementation.

methods.name: removeField
methods.description: Stub method for removing a field; currently returns false.

methods.name: validField
methods.description: Static method that determines if a field definition is valid for display in Studio/ModuleBuilder layout editors.

methods.name: _standardizeFieldLabels
methods.description: Helper method to ensure all field definitions have a label, defaulting to their 'vname' if missing.

methods.name: _trimFieldDefs
methods.description: Static placeholder method to trim or process field definitions.

methods.name: getRequiredFields
methods.description: Returns an array of field names marked as required and not readonly.

methods.name: isTrue
methods.description: Static utility to interpret various values as boolean true or false.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to handle saving metadata, with an optional parameter to populate data.
